outcome: Timing of hair removal at incision site
Reasons for non-adherence to infection control policy
cohort: Doctors and nurses involved in the management of patients who underwent caesarean sections at two tertiary hospitals in Port Harcourt, Nigeria
finding: The implementation of an infection control policy in a tertiary hospital in Port Harcourt, Nigeria led to improvements in certain infection control practices, such as timing of prophylactic antibiotic administration and hair removal, but no difference in awareness of the infection control committee.
